Relations.Title: Relations
Relations.Explanation: Free relationships between Ruleset objects. Link = association; unlock = availability; grant = recorded entitlement. Operations execute when Content is acquired; on other objects they are descriptive. Game effects require a compatible Runtime handler.
Relations.ChoicesExplanation: Choose any Ruleset objects. When Content is acquired, the choice records a link, unlock, or grant entitlement. Concrete game effects require a compatible Runtime handler.

Colors.InheritanceHelp: Subsections inherit their parent section color by default. Enabling overrides allows individual colors in each subsection without deleting stored custom colors when disabled.

Slots.PoolsHelp: Each pool is a bounded runtime value (health, mana…). Bounds are a number or a Formula.
Slots.CollectionsHelp: Each collection holds entries: owned content, references to other entities, or small values.
